name: Image Effects
summary: Ten effects for a photo: glitch, double exposure, neon, sketch, watercolor and more.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/edit's (built by tools/build_apps.py); the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Effect
inputs.default: a heavy digital glitch effect: strong horizontal displacement bands, red and cyan RGB channel split, blocky pixel corruption, scan lines and data-mosh smears across the frame

options.value: a heavy digital glitch effect: strong horizontal displacement bands, red and cyan RGB channel split, blocky pixel corruption, scan lines and data-mosh smears across the frame
options.label: Glitch

options.value: a double exposure: the silhouette of the main subject filled with a pine forest and mountains at dusk, the background faded to white, a soft fine-art blend
options.label: Double exposure

options.value: glowing neon outlines: bright pink and cyan neon tubes trace the edges of the subject and the main shapes, the rest of the photo darkened to near black
options.label: Neon outline

options.value: a graphite pencil sketch look: the whole photo redrawn as a detailed pencil drawing on white paper, hatching for the shadows, no color
options.label: Pencil sketch

options.value: a watercolor painting look: soft washes of color bleeding into each other, visible paper texture, loose brush edges, white paper showing through
options.label: Watercolor

options.value: a pop art look: bold flat colors, thick black outlines and halftone dots, like a 1960s comic print
options.label: Pop art

options.value: a vintage 1970s film photo look: faded warm colors, lifted blacks, heavy film grain, light leaks and a slight blur
options.label: Vintage film

options.value: an infrared photo look: foliage and skin turned pale white and pink, dark skies, high contrast, a dreamy glow
options.label: Infrared

options.value: a red-cyan anaglyph 3D look: the image doubled, a red copy shifted left and a cyan copy shifted right, like an old 3D-glasses print
options.label: Anaglyph 3D

options.value: a thermal camera look: false colors from deep blue for cold to yellow and white for warm, people glowing orange and yellow, no fine texture
options.label: Thermal camera

inputs.label: Extra direction
inputs.help: Added at the end of the app's prompt.

bind.template: Apply {effect} to this photo; the scene stays recognizable. {details}
